meta.marketAtlasDescription: Research publicly traded companies through a calm end-of-day dashboard.

common.educationOnly: Educational purposes only - not investment advice.

landing.label: Stock research dashboard
landing.heading: Market Atlas.
landing.intro: Research U.S. companies through a lightweight Java-powered, end-of-day dashboard.
landing.popularHeading: Start with the names that move markets.
landing.sectorHeading: A useful cross-section of the market.
landing.endOfDay: End-of-day market data · Source and date shown per company
landing.architectureCopy: A Dockerized Java 21 and Spring Boot service normalizes provider data, coalesces concurrent requests, and persists separate quote, history, and statement caches.
prompts: Which company are we looking at?
What market story are you following?
What would you like to compare?
Which company deserves a closer look?
What are you curious about today?

company.unavailable: Market data is temporarily unavailable. The previously displayed company is preserved when possible.
company.chartInspect: Use pointer or arrow keys to inspect prices
company.financialIntro: Up to five reported fiscal years. Open an SEC filing to see the original report when available.
company.financialsIdle: Financials load only when this tab is opened.
company.earningsIntro: Quarterly facts taken from SEC 10-Q filings. Expected dates and analyst estimates will appear only when a permitted source is configured.
company.earningsIdle: Earnings load only when this tab is opened.
company.earningsScope: This SEC view includes quarters with discrete 10-Q facts. It does not infer fourth-quarter EPS from an annual filing.
company.secData: SEC EDGAR · Original filings linked above.

compare.label: Company comparison
compare.heading:
Two companies.
One scale.
compare.intro: Compare normalized performance, then inspect the actual closing prices behind each line.
compare.explainer: Both lines begin at 100. Hover or use arrow keys to see each company’s real closing price on that date.
compare.statementsOptional: Annual statement metrics are optional and cached for seven days.
compare.relativePerformance: Relative performance is rebased to 100 for the selected period.
